scenes.subtitle: A stepped test
scenes.narration: Here is a tiny step by step test scene, one short sentence at a time.

steps.narration: First, bring fresh water to a rolling boil.
Next, add one spoon of tea leaves for each cup.
Finally, let it steep three minutes, then pour and enjoy.
Fresh cold water tastes clearly better in the cup.
Too long makes tea bitter, so keep an eye on the clock.
